summary: American Water Capital Corp. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on May 18, 2026, to offer unsecured senior notes due 20__ with semi-annual interest payments and optional redemption provisions. The notes rank equal with existing senior debt and effectively junior to secured debt, benefit from a support agreement from parent American Water Works Company, Inc., but are not guaranteed by subsidiaries. Proceeds will be lent to the parent and its regulated utility operations. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation transaction; the filing lacks any M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. No advisory, premium, or deal terms are disclosed.
